images.caption: Figure 2:NoPeWorld.Training: every candidate motion is swept through Unreal’s true geometry (top view) and labelled; the head predicts the labels from the frozen DiT’s states (outlined: keeping the input). Inference: raw, the model enters the wall; in prediction mode the head sets the motion between chunksk−1k{-}1andkk; in collision mode it changes an unsafe motion inside chunkkkand reruns step 0.

Figure 3:NoPeBench.Tasks 1 and 2 use the same 100 routes in 32 held-out scenes from UnrealZoo[55], shown by what the camera runs into; Task 1 judges the action on the true history, Task 2 the generated video, on Unreal’s geometry. Task 3 generates from open-domain images with static (WBench) and dynamic obstacles, in first and third person, judged by VLMs.

Figure 4:Task 2: the generated video.One route, six generators, 4 s after the hand-off; + NoPeWorld in collision mode. Input: the hand-off frame (yellow: the obstacle) and the key held. Ground Truth: Unreal Engine. Top View: the reconstructed paths on the true map.

Figure 5:Task 3: open-domain images.Static (WBench) and dynamic obstacles, first and third person, one generator per column. Rows: the first frame, obstacle outlined (SAM 2[32]); the original model;+ NoPeWorld(collision mode) at the same time. By VLM majority, every original shown violates and no+ NoPeWorlddoes.

Figure S2:LingBot-World 2.0on Task 2 routes (yellow: target obstacle tracked by SAM 2 from hand-off). (a) The raw camera passes through the statue to the wall behind it; with NoPeWorld it stops cleanly in front of the statue [through→\tostopped]. (b) The raw camera clips onto the fallen block; with NoPeWorld it slides smoothly along the block towards the pillar [through→\toslid].

Figure S7:Where the head looks(LingBot-World 2.0, collision mode). Top: attention maps (orange) for three candidate motions at first intervention. Bottom left: attention shift across 50 first-person and 40 third-person Unreal routes. Bottom right: single-token depth probe (R2R^{2}, block 16) vs. VAE latents and time.
